narr: Upper level shortwave energy pushed through the region during the early morning hours of August 14, 2024, sparking a band of convection over portions of southwest Missouri. As a result, heavy rain developed, with around 5 inches of rainfall causing areal and flash flooding in Wright, Howell, Douglas, and Ozark counties.
ev: Missouri Highway 142 was closed west of Moody due to flooding.
Highway AB was closed just east of Highway 5 due to flooding.
Highway K southwest of Pottersville was closed due to flooding.
Route Z north of Hartville was closed due to flooding.
